# st-zentao_group (Data Source)

Look up a ZenTao permission group by its numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "st-zentao_group" "by_id" {
  id = "10000002"
}

output "group" {
  value = {
    project = data.st-zentao_group.by_id.project
    name    = data.st-zentao_group.by_id.name
    role    = data.st-zentao_group.by_id.role
    desc    = data.st-zentao_group.by_id.desc
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric ZenTao group ID.

### Read-Only

- `desc` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Group display name.
- `project` (Number) Parent project id (`0` for system groups).
- `role` (String) Free-text role label.
